revokeConfirm.content: The key is invalidated immediately, removed from the list, and cannot be recovered. All gateway requests using it will be blocked.

disableConfirm.title: Disable API Key?
disableConfirm.desc: "{{name}}" will stop working immediately after it is disabled. You can re-enable it later.

createModal.title: Create API Key
createModal.desc: Create a runtime credential for workspace {{workspaceName}}
createModal.maintainerRequired: Select an owner for the service key
createModal.noTypePermission: You do not have permission to create this key type
createModal.advancedDesc: Configure security policies bound to this key

createdModal.title: API Key created
createdModal.desc: Copy and save it now. You cannot view the full key again after closing this dialog.

rotateModal.title: Rotation complete
rotateModal.desc: The new token is active and shown only once. Copy and save it now. The old token remains in the grace period; click Rotated after verification to invalidate it.

rotateConfirm.title: Confirm rotation completion
rotateConfirm.desc: After confirmation, the old token is invalidated immediately and the new token remains active.

rotate.noticeTitle: The new token is active; the old token is still valid
rotate.noticeDesc: Copy the new token and replace it in callers. After verification, click Rotated to invalidate the old token immediately.

revealModal.title: Your new API Key is ready
revealModal.warning: Please save this credential immediately. For security, the plaintext API key is shown only once.
revealModal.label: Plain Text API Key:
revealModal.done: I have copied and saved it

connectModal.title: Connect now
connectModal.desc: Choose a connection method to view parameters. Buttons open tools or documentation.
connectModal.keyCreatedHint: The API key is shown only once after creation. Save it before closing this banner.
connectModal.noKeyHint: Review endpoints and connection methods first. Create an API key to copy complete parameters.
connectModal.revealError: Failed to retrieve the API key plaintext. Please try again later.
connectModal.mgcTitle: Connect AI coding clients with one command
connectModal.mgcDesc: Select the clients to connect. The command is prefilled with the key and site ({{site}}); copy it into a terminal and press Enter.
connectModal.keyInjected: Your newly created key is filled in
connectModal.keyAutoFill: A real key will be filled in after you create one
